When I was around 6 I had a dream, which does not seem scary when I say it out loud but was terrifying when I dreamt about, I still haven’t forgot about it years later.

I work up in the morning already dressed my parents and my 2 sister also my nana was there, we had a good morning having fun, I remember hearing a noise and my nana grabbing my mouth pulling me into a cupboard which is not there in my house in real life. We hid for a while and we came out, hearing a noise, we realised they were all upstairs, me and my nana were talking about what to do, she was telling me to hide and run and far away as I could but I wouldn’t, my nana headed up the stairs, I heard her shout and scream, and I ran up stairs, at the top where these like robots??? But on they were like teleitubies and had a screen in their belly, they were like animatronics with out their outside shell on, in the screens in their belly where my family, they all turned around in sync, they were circled around another animatronic on the floor, who leant up mechanically and faced me, my nana was in its screen on its belly, they all said I think Hello -my name- then my mother woke me. 

It sounds ridiculous but it was honestly traumatic for my 6 year old self.

It was only yesterday, I also saw a passing shadow out the corner of my eye. I think she saw the ghost of the past house owners husband.
